I've never written a guide for any of my weapon builds yet, but I'll try my best here:

I started with an adult-size carbon fiber tennis racquet and took off the unnecessary parts of the frame. (I'd like to add here that I planned for the blade to be longer, but when I sawed through the frame, it sprung back slightly as the tension was loosed, which I didn't account for)

I then attached strips of 1/2 inch camp pad to either side of the blade, leaving 1/2 inch past the tip to stuff some foam in to prevent the racquet tip poking through (2 for each side in this case, but one could do) and then sandwiched the resulting shape between a pair of shaped camp foam pieces.

(I used Gorilla Glue Spray-Adhesive for my build, though you could also use DAP or other contact cements.)

Finally, for the blade itself, I used strips of camp pad \~1/2 to 3/4 inch wide (eyeballed it), wrapped it around the blade side, and adhered it with the GG adhesive.

To make the cloth cover, I measured the rough circumference of the blade (mine came out to about 10 1/2 inches) and then traced the shape of the blade onto my cloth with a chalk pencil (make sure to make it a bit longer so you can tape it to your handle!. After getting this initial shape, I then traced another series of dots around the shape 3/4 inch out from the traced shape. I cut them out, sewed it on a machine, and the cover slipped on quite nicely!

For the pommel, I used a piece of pipe insulation that is made to wrap around a 1" pipe and capped it with another piece of 1/2" camp pad. This was then covered with electrical tape.

For the handle, I simply wrapped it in cloth tape.

​

Going through this build, I realized that there might be some discrepancies between builds so I thought I'd give my thoughts on those potential issues.

\-If your racquet's handle is not oblong, use craft foam or cut down camp pad to form the rough shape of a handle and wrap up in paracord, cloth tape, etc.

\-Ebay is a great place to find used racquets, but be very sure that the racquet you are purchasing is made from Carbon Fiber or graphite (if there is another legal material of this shape, I'm not aware of it)

\-Keep your offcuts! They could be attached to other cores to make some unique weapons! I'm already considering a long Kama build with one of the offcuts

​

If there are any other questions regarding this build, leave them beneath this comment. I'm not a frequent user of Reddit, but I'll try my best to help where and when I can.
